name: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd
title: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd-$ - 531266 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 revenue up 25% to INR1,240 crore with operational EBITDA margin up 220bp to 13.4%, but management declined to guide FY27 volume growth and flagged fuel/commodity inflation and monsoon risk.

triggers.label: Price hike across products, end-April
triggers.quote: We have taken a price increase towards end of April.

triggers.label: Receivable days 75 → 51
triggers.quote: In FY25 we had taken receivables to about 75 days. We have brought it down this year to 51 days

triggers.label: FY27 growth explicitly not guided
triggers.quote: I am desisting from giving a growth percent for this year.

triggers.label: Industry growth flattish risk acknowledged
triggers.quote: I kind of tend to agree there's no reason for that high growth that happened to continue.

guidance.quote: we are positive that we will be able to operate between 12% to 14%.
We are targeting thousand numbers this year.
by FY30 we should be able to do 5,000 to 6,000 numbers.
We want to grow it to 20% retail finance this financial year.
I am desisting from giving a growth percent for this year.

prior_guidance_check.metric: Revenue CAGR 23-26% to INR3,000 crore by FY30
prior_guidance_check.quote: if we are able to do around 23% to 26% continuously on a CAGR up till FY30 we will get to our goal of INR3 ,000 crores.
we are moving more towards 13% and 13% plus than the 11% guidance.

red_flags.label: Half of balance sheet in investments; Zimeno US investment provisioned
red_flags.quote: As far as the investment is concerned, we have provisioned for those investments already.

red_flags.label: Fair value loss in Q4; FY26 loss INR6 crore vs prior-year gain INR24 crore
red_flags.quote: Against that there's a loss of INR6 crores in the current year.

red_flags.quote: Fertilizer availability looks like a problem.
